summary: Pinned and materialized the full primary 1979 article with byte-identical Wayback fallback. Read pp.335–341; layout extraction of the same bytes resolves two-column ordering. Formalized the published simplified deductive core with typed beings, events, outcomes and counterfactual/comparative costs; a finite interpretation keeps apparent pointlessness, narrow theism and permission constraint together through an unrecognized actual cost. Preserved p.336 nn.2–3 unreplaceability, non-temporal/justice goods and balance-neutral refinement. Instantiated the same structured theorem with the suggested refined constraint and correspondingly stronger factual premise, without claiming equivalence. Rejected apparent-to-actual entailment, treating a good drawn from evil as an unavoidable sufficient justifier, identification of natural suffering with culpa, and automatically applying O’Connor’s emotivist sentence semantics to Rowe. Total-evidence warrant remains in ROWE-EVIL-TOTAL-EVIDENCE-WARRANT and docs/rowe-evidential-evil.md. No premise truth or root closure follows. Follow-up analyst recognition batch (attribution deferred): finite outcome survey coverage plus recognition completeness transforms the same apparent event into actual gratuitous suffering. Empty and singleton surveys on the existing hidden-cost model independently refute dropping these inputs; a cost-free model gives joint nonvacuity. Composition retains the simplified permission condition. Root target UniqueClassicalGodExists still requires a common-carrier attribute bridge; no probability, actual applicability, or root discharge is claimed. See docs/rowe-evidential-evil.md and specs/rowe-recognition.toml.
